scenes.headline: How a voice model listens and speaks at once
scenes.sub: PersonaPlex: Moshi with a role prompt and a voice prompt
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Murmur! PersonaPlex hears you while it talks. Here's how, and how it takes a persona.

scenes.text: There are no turns. Every 80 ms the model predicts its own next frame of words and sound, while your audio streams in beside it.
scenes.say: There are no turns. Every eighty milliseconds, the model predicts its own next frame of words and sound, while your audio streams in beside it.

steps.say: Your voice becomes eight codec tokens per frame.
They join seventeen streams: the model's text, its own sound, and yours.
A big transformer reads the whole column, one step per frame.
A small one writes the next column: a word first, then its sound.
That sound is decoded and played. Listening is just predicting silence.

left.title: A cascade
items: A voice detector waits for silence
left.say: A cascade waits for a voice detector to hear silence.

right.title: Full duplex
right.say: Here, saying yeah while you talk, or stopping when you cut in, is the same next token prediction.

scenes.title: A system prompt written into the grid
scenes.say: So how do you prompt a model with no turns? Write the prompt into the grid.

items.text: Voice sample on its own audio
items.say: A voice sample goes onto its own audio.

items.text: Role text on its own text
items.say: The role goes onto its inner monologue.

items.text: A sine tone on your channel
items.say: Your channel holds a steady tone: nobody is talking yet.

steps.say: The paper's figure: voice prompt, pause, text prompt, pause.

scenes.label: of attention: 3,000 frames in a ring cache
scenes.note: The prompt is the oldest frames, so it is the first to go
scenes.say: One catch, read from the code: the prompt is the oldest part of a ring cache, so after about four minutes it slides out of view.

scenes.title: Time to stop when you cut in
scenes.say: Cut it off, and it stops in a quarter of a second. Systems that wait for silence take over a second.

scenes.text: A full-duplex model's system prompt has to be something that happened on its own streams.
scenes.say: The idea to keep: a full duplex system prompt has to happen on the model's own streams.

recap: Seventeen token streams, one column every 80 ms
Persona and voice are forced onto its own streams
scenes.say: Seventeen streams. Turn taking is prediction. The persona lives in the model's own voice and thoughts.
